title: Low-description role codes for selective state-space decay
hypothesis: A small role coordinate that shifts shared selective-SSM log-decay can realize multiple token-selective dynamics with lower actual payload than full per-role SSM copies.
physical_object: One fixed Mamba-like selective diagonal SSM with state dimension 16; token input controls delta, B_t and C_t through shared scalar/vector gates.
mirror_coordinate: One scalar m_r per role shifts all shared log decay rates: A_log(r)=A_log+m_r. The rest of the selective recurrence is physically shared.
logical_multiplicity: Twelve role-specific recurrent functions process independent input sequences through one shared SSM state transition structure.

task.role_codes: Fixed evenly spaced m values in [-0.6,0.6]; each role code is explicit paid inference state.
task.input: Per seed, independent standard-normal inputs with deterministic sparse impulses; the recurrence and input values are shared across methods.
task.scope: Minimal Mamba-like selective SSM mechanism only; not a full Mamba block, language model, or trained task benchmark. No learning occurs.

controls: native per-role decay-bias conditioning, algebraically identical to adding m_r to A_log
independent full per-role copies of A/B/C and all selective gate parameters

development.selection_metric: serialized-output NRMSE to the FP32 reference, actual compressed inference payload bytes, role diversity, and steady-state tokens/s
development.runtime_protocol: deserialize once; warm up five full batches; time ten repeats on one CPU thread. Report one-time deserialization separately.

storage.format: compressed NPZ, FP16 parameters/role codes and uint8 role IDs
paid_objects: all shared or independent recurrent parameters
every role code or per-role parameter copy

compute.include: Report zero training examples/updates, processed inference tokens, recurrence operations per token, one-time deserialize time, and steady-state tokens/s.

success_gate: Both development seeds: role-conditioned NRMSE <=0.01, actual bytes <=0.80x independent full SSM copies, throughput >=0.80x native decay-bias control, and role diversity RMS >=0.01. No exact native-control alias may explain the result. Passing only qualifies for fresh confirmation.
failure_gate: FAIL if any seed misses quality, bytes, runtime or meaningful diversity gate, or if the native per-role decay-bias control exactly reproduces the paid state and outputs with no incremental Mirror-specific benefit.
boundaries: This only screens a minimal selective diagonal recurrence, not Mamba quality or sequence-model performance.
All weights are fixed random deterministic vectors; no learned-task claim is made.
Role-dependent decay is a conventional native SSM conditioning axis and is expected to have an exact alias control.
Fresh seeds stay sealed unless both development seeds pass every gate.
